text: We have no choice, you and I, but to obey our instructions. We are not free to follow our own devices, you and I.” As she looked at me in giving me the purse, I hoped there was an inner meaning in her words. She said them slightingly, but not with displeasure. “A carriage will have to be sent for, Estella. Will you rest here a little?” “Yes, I am to rest here a little, and I am to drink some tea, and you are to take care of me the while.” She drew her arm through mine, as if it must be done, and I requested a waiter who had been staring at the coach like a man who had never seen such a thing in his life, to show us a private sitting-room.
